column1: # Hub revision of every weight tree on the two weight volumes, for rebuilds
# weights-manifest.tsv keeps its three columns (dest, hub_id, globs) because
# runpod.sh and the tests parse it; the revision lives here.
#   recorded   the full SHA is written in this repo (manifest comment, fetch log or port doc)
#   short      a short SHA is recorded (docs/gaps/2026-09-27-volume-sync.md);
#              expanded to 40 hex with the Hub API (GET /api/models/<repo>/revision/<short>)
#   inferred   no revision recorded. These trees were fetched unpinned (hf-fm, `main`)
#              no earlier than 2026-09-22. Each repo's `main` has not changed
#              since before that date (Hub lastModified, read on 2026-09-30), so
#              `main` then = the SHA here. Confirm against a surviving volume's
#   unpinned   the fetcher itself takes `main` (fetch-mmaudio.py pins md5s, not
#              revisions). The SHA is today's `main`; its lastModified is before the
#              2026-09-27 fetch, so it is also what the volumes hold (inferred as above).
#              `unknown`: the Hub API answers 307 (repo moved) for this id.
# fetch-h3-ref2va.py (pins its own revisions); mmaudio = fetch-mmaudio.py.
